009d02c15d.speaker: dobra
009d02c15d.text: You won't. They never are. Hand me that. No, the long one.

014d33035c.speaker: vesna
014d33035c.text: Where did the three go out from?

03451ead62.speaker: vesna
03451ead62.text: Are you the one who makes the effigies?

034595943e.speaker: vesna
034595943e.text: She asked if her mother sent me.

03ca2bb317.speaker: bogdan
03ca2bb317.text: I don't read the board. I know what's on it.

06ac5a46f7.speaker: hanka
06ac5a46f7.text: Marta had my arm. I thought it was the torches. You look at torches and then you see things on the ice. Spots.

0735fbb535.speaker: child_f1
0735fbb535.text: If you look back she gets you!

08e94a25d8.speaker: vesna
08e94a25d8.text: The miller's father wouldn't let anyone fish near them. You put your hand in a hole there and it isn't cold like the others.

0ea4534c21.speaker: dobra
0ea4534c21.text: There's nothing to make. I keep picking up straw anyway.

0ff94047e8.speaker: hanka
0ff94047e8.text: The camp, past the huts, west of the poles. Three holes. Stach had the one nearest the poles.

108e49a90f.speaker: zbyszek
108e49a90f.text: It's thin. I know it's thin. You try brewing with what we've got.

10c61a9c22.speaker: bogdan
10c61a9c22.text: You've still got my hundred. The pass was open this morning.

12355ed2a3.speaker: zbyszek
12355ed2a3.text: Stach was fifty-odd, with a bad knee and a good net. Bolek was younger. Bolek owes me eleven grosze. Owed. I only say it because I wrote it down.

16b9b37493.speaker: vesna
16b9b37493.text: What do they do with her tomorrow night?

16dc65fa5f.speaker: zbyszek
16dc65fa5f.text: Shut the door behind you, you're letting the heat out.

18bc795506.speaker: vesna
18bc795506.text: How old is it, the rite?

1f42dac4f1.speaker: vesna
1f42dac4f1.text: She goes where I go. She doesn't like it.

2350584f17.speaker: bogdan
2350584f17.text: The elders. Pawlak, Rybak, the old women. It isn't a thing I decided.

235c14c27c.speaker: bogdan
235c14c27c.text: At half a measure? Five weeks. Less, if anyone else comes over the pass.

24cd0888c1.speaker: villager_m1
24cd0888c1.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

25152716f7.speaker: bogdan
25152716f7.text: I don't know why I counted.

2761e22fc7.speaker: vesna
2761e22fc7.text: Why not take it out there yourself?

27cc7768bd.speaker: hanka
27cc7768bd.text: A woman came round with a red ribbon. She measured Ola's wrists with it.

28c45ec6e8.speaker: bogdan
28c45ec6e8.text: There's a hundred and eighty-six of us. You can do sums.

29b7046970.speaker: hanka
29b7046970.text: I'll be on the ice tonight. Whatever you do.

2b1b72ad2b.speaker: zbyszek
2b1b72ad2b.text: That's for Bogdan. He's the one with the sums.

2c7a48f09b.speaker: child_m1
2c7a48f09b.text: If you look back she gets you!

2e9d5ce38b.speaker: dobra
2e9d5ce38b.text: Every year I make her and every year they drown her. My mother made them before me.

308aceac37.speaker: jarek
308aceac37.text: I was drunk. I was drunk the night they cut the hole.

32d99ce451.speaker: jarek
32d99ce451.text: Maybe I cut it in the wrong place. Maybe the ice was thin because of me.

33cf10d693.speaker: zbyszek
33cf10d693.text: Three winters. I had onions behind the house. I've still got the box.

345323d7a4.speaker: dobra
345323d7a4.text: Then he came out. He was hungry.

356b87b5b4.speaker: hanka
356b87b5b4.text: Pull the door hard, it sticks.

384908da1a.speaker: hanka
384908da1a.text: That's what they say. I don't go out after dark.

38d6389af6.speaker: zbyszek
38d6389af6.text: I'm not charging for yesterday's. Sit by the stove.

3ae7530fef.speaker: vesna
3ae7530fef.text: It's on the table, at the top of the tower.

3bf1b99dc4.speaker: hanka
3bf1b99dc4.text: Take it. It's what I've got.

3c28d2cf43.speaker: vesna
3c28d2cf43.text: There is a contract on the board. Who put it there?

3ede5454f3.speaker: hanka
3ede5454f3.text: Ola's at the hill. I let her go.

3f0a352cd4.speaker: hanka
3f0a352cd4.text: On the hill with the others. I said back by dark.

3fa2be5fff.speaker: hanka
3fa2be5fff.text: I left it long. She'll grow into it.

4049070564.speaker: hanka
4049070564.text: I know. I know it is.

4132c9ead6.speaker: zbyszek
4132c9ead6.text: I didn't have anything to say to that.

43464e935c.speaker: vesna
43464e935c.text: I'll be at the shore at dark.

442421c60d.speaker: zbyszek
442421c60d.text: H.? Only Hanka writes that fair. Her man was the scribe before the fever took him.

4560be5114.speaker: vesna
4560be5114.text: Hanka's older girl. Wiesia. Did you know her?

480b081b90.speaker: dobra
480b081b90.text: A hunter came through. One of yours. Lynx. We had nothing to give him.

48267e7874.speaker: bogdan
48267e7874.text: I'm the reeve. I count the grain.

48a96dd13f.speaker: vesna
48a96dd13f.text: And before the equinox, it says.

4c8e6cc69e.speaker: zbyszek
4c8e6cc69e.text: Work. There's a paper on the board since the morning. Go and read it.

4d6c29ed91.speaker: zbyszek
4d6c29ed91.text: We've done it three years running. Look outside.

4e1d5d20c3.speaker: vesna
4e1d5d20c3.text: You don't know that it was you.

4e965438db.speaker: dobra
4e965438db.text: In the morning. I have more hands in the morning.

4f725fdf5b.speaker: zbyszek
4f725fdf5b.text: He goes out there every day anyway. I'll tell his wife. After the rite.

5104b160cf.speaker: vesna
5104b160cf.text: Is that all it is worth to you?

540834e1d0.speaker: dobra
540834e1d0.text: Too tight, it'll snap. Like that.

5475504278.speaker: dobra
5475504278.text: Took half the night, some nights.

5578a9da50.speaker: zbyszek
5578a9da50.text: She keeps to herself. House on the shore, east, past the huts. There's a bowl of milk by the door, you can't miss it. Don't ask her about the milk.

564a51d2f9.speaker: bogdan
564a51d2f9.text: I've nothing for you. I'm counting torches.

5681364bec.speaker: hanka
5681364bec.text: Go and bring the wood in.

56a020cbe3.speaker: zbyszek
56a020cbe3.text: That one's mine. The next is a grosze.

57204bc0fc.speaker: zbyszek
57204bc0fc.text: Ask the reeve. It's not my business and I'm not saying it.

5752960ef0.speaker: zbyszek
5752960ef0.text: It's a long way out and a long way back and it's cold. You sing loud.

57e4391ac7.speaker: vesna
57e4391ac7.text: The paper says something walks the ice.

584330c387.speaker: zbyszek
584330c387.text: And the Wrona boy, seventeen. That's his father you'll see at the holes.

5bf9686a93.speaker: miller_wife
5bf9686a93.text: Kill them, and you can have whatever is in the pot.

5c06b61382.speaker: bogdan
5c06b61382.text: Stach had four at home. Pawlak's taken them on her share, and Pawlak's a widow. That's seven mouths on one share, if you want it plain.

5c1ae02f73.speaker: zbyszek
5c1ae02f73.text: Don't. Not today. If he knows he'll want to go out there.

5c36be15ce.speaker: zbyszek
5c36be15ce.text: There's a barrel in the cellar I put by the first winter. For when it ended. It'll have turned by now.

5d942c6607.speaker: vesna
5d942c6607.text: Gniewko the miller says his father wouldn't let anyone fish by the poles. Warm water comes up there.

5e2aa00076.speaker: villager_m3
5e2aa00076.text: Ice is thick here. Thick as my head.

5e457ce85b.speaker: dobra
5e457ce85b.text: She'd only go home and think about it.

5ec0ce8a7d.speaker: dobra
5ec0ce8a7d.text: Bogdan's been out to look at those stones. Twice this winter.

5f7f9c78e0.speaker: vesna
5f7f9c78e0.text: I'll go out when it's dark.

5fadcaace6.speaker: zbyszek
5fadcaace6.text: Everybody goes. I carry a torch. It's my turn. It's been my turn every year, I don't know how that works.

60fee1d4ca.speaker: vesna
60fee1d4ca.text: I came over the pass. There was a cart on the road. A man, a woman, a small girl.

610f7e7233.speaker: vesna
610f7e7233.text: I saw what happened. Three years ago.

626e7791eb.speaker: bogdan
626e7791eb.text: It's always cut there. My father cut it there.

66b3dd2c35.speaker: villager_m2
66b3dd2c35.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

67d5587142.speaker: bogdan
67d5587142.text: Tomorrow night we do the rite, and that's the end of it.

681d86b9dc.speaker: bogdan
681d86b9dc.text: It will snow. It always snows.

687f9abf80.speaker: hanka
687f9abf80.text: It's nothing. It freezes by morning anyway.

6b2ac0ef66.speaker: villager_f1
6b2ac0ef66.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

6d661dfcfb.speaker: zbyszek
6d661dfcfb.text: Hear that? The roof. It hasn't stopped dripping since morning. I've buckets on every floor.

6d99f1d4c4.speaker: dobra
6d99f1d4c4.text: Torches, and a pole, and the hair isn't done. Don't stand there.

6de5923f0c.speaker: vesna
6de5923f0c.text: Your mother puts a bowl of milk out at the door.

6e5a50a6c6.speaker: bogdan
6e5a50a6c6.text: I told you to get out.

6f1d3ac154.speaker: hanka
6f1d3ac154.text: It's too long. She'll catch her heel on it.

6fe4f80236.speaker: zbyszek
6fe4f80236.text: Then come back when you have. I'd give it to you. I can't, they'd all want it.

6fe545b245.speaker: jarek
6fe545b245.text: I gave her a scarf once. She said it itched. She wore it all the same.

73e75a31af.speaker: dobra
73e75a31af.text: Older than me. There's old stones out on the island with pictures cut in them.

7411f21055.speaker: dobra
7411f21055.text: My boy, when he was little, he'd get under the bed when it thundered. You couldn't pull him out. You had to sit on the floor and wait.

74dc35e39a.speaker: dobra
74dc35e39a.text: Mind the straw on your way out.

76d8a451ad.speaker: dobra
76d8a451ad.text: You walk her out, you burn her, in she goes, you walk back singing. You don't turn round. That's all there is to it.

793738ae7a.speaker: hanka
793738ae7a.text: Is there anything else you need to know?

796b0e9e5e.speaker: vesna
796b0e9e5e.text: For a bit. Then it doesn't.

79ac281702.speaker: vesna
79ac281702.text: What do you do with it?

7a40d5edcf.speaker: bogdan
7a40d5edcf.text: Sixty. I need eighty. Dobra has the girls making them.

7b8e4a09a7.speaker: jarek
7b8e4a09a7.text: You're going out there. To her.

7c5b5fbb5a.speaker: dobra
7c5b5fbb5a.text: Next year's. I'll start in the autumn.

7d1b42543b.speaker: zbyszek
7d1b42543b.text: The girl's picked, anyway. Last week.

7d774ff86e.speaker: vesna
7d774ff86e.text: Tell me how the rite goes.

7ee5baa4bd.speaker: vesna
7ee5baa4bd.text: I have a horse, if you want to see her.

7f20b1addd.speaker: zbyszek
7f20b1addd.text: It was snowing, you couldn't see the one beside you.

7f63a6940f.speaker: vesna
7f63a6940f.text: There's a paper on the board in the square. Three men, it says.

7fea5c2a4c.speaker: vesna
7fea5c2a4c.text: Is there any work here for a hunter?

80074d0c4a.speaker: bogdan
80074d0c4a.text: It's a deep lake. I'm not sending a man out to look for three men I've already lost.

8046f414e1.speaker: zbyszek
8046f414e1.text: Old Wrona goes out to the holes every morning. Sits there till dark.

84e6ff0fa3.speaker: vesna
84e6ff0fa3.text: I was at the poles last night. I saw it.

8956f5d483.speaker: hanka
8956f5d483.text: I take milk down every night. She liked it warm. I can't get it out there warm.

89d1db3e14.speaker: vesna
89d1db3e14.text: He had a letter on him. Tomasz.

8a9f0e5fb5.speaker: vesna
8a9f0e5fb5.text: It wasn't you. Warm water comes up under the poles.

8b8e9f0fd5.speaker: zbyszek
8b8e9f0fd5.text: In the line. Near the back, with the torches.

8baee73532.speaker: dobra
8baee73532.text: By the door. You'll be out of my light.

8e628a6d1c.speaker: vesna
8e628a6d1c.text: I'll leave it where she'll find it.

8e7c30346c.speaker: hanka
8e7c30346c.text: She'll be back before dark. She's been told.

8e947fb4c3.speaker: dobra
8e947fb4c3.text: Mine. I tie every one. Why, did they come undone?

9322da430d.speaker: vesna
9322da430d.text: I found your three. They're under the ice, out by the old tower.

9350629935.speaker: zbyszek
9350629935.text: Wipe your boots, I've done the floor twice.

938e59e04d.speaker: bogdan
938e59e04d.text: Everybody knows not to fish there.

93a65dcee5.speaker: hanka
93a65dcee5.text: By the time I got back there was just slush.

953eb8263e.speaker: vesna
953eb8263e.text: Who have you been talking to?

9af387aebd.speaker: zbyszek
9af387aebd.text: Nobody's paid for it since the autumn, so I'm not asking.

9bad85dd30.speaker: vesna
9bad85dd30.text: Wiesia didn't just fall in. Her mother saw her in the water, and everyone kept walking.

9d32bcec1a.speaker: vesna
9d32bcec1a.text: What have you got for the cold, besides soup?

9d72dfb7a2.speaker: zbyszek
9d72dfb7a2.text: She's eleven. She comes round for the scraps for the goat and I give her a bit extra. Don't tell anyone.

a1c07f581e.speaker: bogdan
a1c07f581e.text: I haven't got two hundred. I haven't got a hundred, if I'm honest. Take it or don't.

a20e7ca6e5.speaker: dobra
a20e7ca6e5.text: She helped me one winter. Good hands. Tied a better knot than me by the end. Don't tell her mother I said that.

a33da5da9d.speaker: vesna
a33da5da9d.text: Who else knew them? Anyone who would talk?

a600660b7a.speaker: dobra
a600660b7a.text: I'm the one making this one. Mind the straw.

a616361280.speaker: hanka
a616361280.text: It doesn't matter which. She was polite about it.

a7ae130770.speaker: vesna
a7ae130770.text: Your cap is in that drift.

a95e55df62.speaker: vesna
a95e55df62.text: Your husband put up a paper.

aa0ad674b2.speaker: vesna
aa0ad674b2.text: Three in a month. And no bodies.

aa34d716f5.speaker: hanka
aa34d716f5.text: They say the goddess took one from this house, so she'll want the other. That's what they're saying.

ab20b31423.speaker: zbyszek
ab20b31423.text: Out past the poles. I wasn't going to go and measure.

ab399d86f8.speaker: zbyszek
ab399d86f8.text: Stach's coat is still on the hook there. His wife hasn't come for it. I can't hang anything else on it.

ae7af33206.speaker: dobra
ae7af33206.text: Put it on that pile. No, the other pile.

aea0d8588e.speaker: hanka
aea0d8588e.text: It's all there is in the house.

af6e5609cb.speaker: zbyszek
af6e5609cb.text: And Jarek went out with Stach. He's in from dark, the corner there. He pays for one and I don't ask about the rest.

b55809115c.speaker: zbyszek
b55809115c.text: Went to their holes at dusk and the holes were empty in the morning. Not even the stools.

b593dd389b.speaker: bogdan
b593dd389b.text: The goddess took one from that house. She's owed the other.

b617cbee8d.speaker: zbyszek
b617cbee8d.text: You look like you've been dragged behind something.

b78b9f8943.speaker: vesna
b78b9f8943.text: I know. I wanted to look at the shore first.

b7e621add0.speaker: vesna
b7e621add0.text: His name was Wit. He told me he found me in a ditch.

b92dcd5192.speaker: zbyszek
b92dcd5192.text: The rite's tomorrow night. Equinox. We drown Marzanna and the winter goes.

ba52be003a.speaker: zbyszek
ba52be003a.text: Why's anyone. He's had a bad few years.

bba7bed445.speaker: zbyszek
bba7bed445.text: I know that. It's for after.

bbc3387849.speaker: dobra
bbc3387849.text: Not there either, that's the hair.

bc496aa43a.speaker: zbyszek
bc496aa43a.text: Three gone this month. Stach, Bolek, and the younger Wrona.

bcdd605e48.speaker: villager_f2
bcdd605e48.text: Hear that? No. Nothing. Go on.

be2e653769.speaker: zbyszek
be2e653769.text: Everybody knew them. Old Wrona's by the door most mornings, if you've the stomach.

bee290347a.speaker: hanka
bee290347a.text: If whatever's out there is dead before tomorrow night, they'll have no reason.

bf653e7836.speaker: vesna
bf653e7836.text: I left the bird where she would see it.

bfdac2307a.speaker: dobra
bfdac2307a.text: There was a winter, before you'd remember anything. We were boiling bark. The wolves came down and got into the graves.

c05ca3c7c6.speaker: zbyszek
c05ca3c7c6.text: I've been up since four, emptying buckets. Mind the one by the door.

c08d8c90d9.speaker: bogdan
c08d8c90d9.text: I light it when the ink freezes. It hasn't frozen.

c1383fed5a.speaker: bogdan
c1383fed5a.text: We went into the winter with ninety sacks of rye. There are forty-one.

c17594ad5c.speaker: vesna
c17594ad5c.text: Three years ago. At the rite. Where were you?

c24736fc4c.speaker: vesna
c24736fc4c.text: There is a room at the top of the drowned tower. Seventeen straw figures sitting round a table.

c547c67bd0.speaker: zbyszek
c547c67bd0.text: Thaw draughts. Twelve grosze, and before you say anything, I don't set the price.

c5c19f3eb7.speaker: vesna
c5c19f3eb7.text: Only on the ice. She doesn't like it.

c5d0465ae1.speaker: ola
c5d0465ae1.text: It's heavy. I have to practise.

c671947d95.speaker: vesna
c671947d95.text: How long has it been like this?

c8ab0de955.speaker: bogdan
c8ab0de955.text: The offer's still good until the morning. After that I need it for wood.

c905b94bce.speaker: zbyszek
c905b94bce.text: What did you want, a goose?

c97abdd418.speaker: hanka
c97abdd418.text: She carries the effigy. That's what they say.

cb4f704a11.speaker: bogdan
cb4f704a11.text: A hundred grosze. The pass will take one rider, if she's careful.

cc84a6f6a8.speaker: bogdan
cc84a6f6a8.text: And stay off the lake. People go through it.

cd00f0b793.speaker: dobra
cd00f0b793.text: I had a baby I couldn't feed.

cd1a7f1cf1.speaker: miller
cd1a7f1cf1.text: Mind the bank. The ice over the race is bad.

ce5b8d7815.speaker: vesna
ce5b8d7815.text: You won't know till you open it.

cf2a33fc41.speaker: dobra
cf2a33fc41.text: He came back. Years after. Asked did I want to know where you were.

cfc76d5c21.speaker: zbyszek
cfc76d5c21.text: He came in here and asked about the road. I told him don't. He said Mira wouldn't have another winter. Zosia had a cough.

d0a8cac30f.speaker: zbyszek
d0a8cac30f.text: Shut the door, you're letting the heat out.

d0b6778162.speaker: zbyszek
d0b6778162.text: I'm not sure of anything. I said only Hanka writes that fair. I didn't say it was her.

d0cba1d4a1.speaker: jarek
d0cba1d4a1.text: She'd ask that. She used to wait at the door for her to come in.

d1323d1b63.speaker: bogdan
d1323d1b63.text: A hundred. You won't be offered it twice.

d2c919a972.speaker: zbyszek
d2c919a972.text: Thaw draughts. Twelve grosze, and I don't set the price.

d2e4cdfa20.speaker: zbyszek
d2e4cdfa20.text: Buy him one if you want him to talk. Don't buy him three.

d2ef8053cf.speaker: vesna
d2ef8053cf.text: I heard you're carrying her this year.

d4411e99ae.speaker: bogdan
d4411e99ae.text: They went through the ice. It happens every winter.

d5c30b6078.speaker: bogdan
d5c30b6078.text: If you're coming tonight, stay at the back.

d73844fb35.speaker: vesna
d73844fb35.text: Do you know what it is?

d7d8bd4cfd.speaker: zbyszek
d7d8bd4cfd.text: I didn't count. Four. Five. I had a line out, I'm allowed to have a line out.

d8c963e1e6.speaker: zbyszek
d8c963e1e6.text: Soup, if you want it. Two grosze.

d9352f8539.speaker: vesna
d9352f8539.text: How long does one take to make?

daacf7bbcc.speaker: hanka
daacf7bbcc.text: Wiesiu, I'm here. I'm sorry. I'm here.

df1dcef385.speaker: zbyszek
df1dcef385.text: Well, it's not going anywhere. I've two.

e0ae545f99.speaker: jarek
e0ae545f99.text: That's good. Did she see it?

e1f37faea3.speaker: dobra
e1f37faea3.text: Nothing to make. First time in my life.

e517f71578.speaker: dobra
e517f71578.text: Because you don't. My mother didn't. Her mother didn't.

e7b4776761.speaker: vesna
e7b4776761.text: I was in your cellar. You've been giving your own ration to the Nowak children.

e7ca4aff01.speaker: vesna
e7ca4aff01.text: That song. Do you know all of it?

e97a959514.speaker: hanka
e97a959514.text: The wood needs splitting. She can't swing the axe.

ea7a9237aa.speaker: dobra
ea7a9237aa.text: My grandmother used to say it was real girls once, before the straw. I don't know. She said a lot of things.

ec1d131280.speaker: vesna
ec1d131280.text: Frozen bread on the table. A music box. And a girl asked if her mother sent me.

edb030476f.speaker: dobra
edb030476f.text: Three days. Two, if nobody talks to me.

eddcc786d3.speaker: hanka
eddcc786d3.text: There's no fire, I'm sorry. I only light it when Ola's in.

ef67f09857.speaker: zbyszek
ef67f09857.text: Something's out there at night. I've seen it from the shore. Like people walking, but wrong. Slow.

f1cba0cb5f.speaker: vesna
f1cba0cb5f.text: You said the goddess took one from this house.

f3b3e7f545.speaker: jarek
f3b3e7f545.text: I made this. For the rite. For after. I was going to give it to her after.

f3c17827b7.speaker: bogdan
f3c17827b7.text: I've nothing to say to you.

f401628e6b.speaker: jarek
f401628e6b.text: They come to the rowan by the well. She'd stand under it an hour.

f4e31660e2.speaker: vesna
f4e31660e2.text: I'm working in the village, on the ice. Out by the poles.

f6708ae4ef.speaker: zbyszek
f6708ae4ef.text: I'm shutting at seven tonight. Everyone goes.

f696410546.speaker: hanka
f696410546.text: She drowned. Three years ago. At the rite.

f6e95ae03c.speaker: bogdan
f6e95ae03c.text: A girl from the village. Same as every year.

f73680a90d.speaker: vesna
f73680a90d.text: I was out at the poles last night.

fa7ec173d8.speaker: zbyszek
fa7ec173d8.text: Upstairs, end of the landing. Boots off.

fd9566fabf.speaker: hanka
fd9566fabf.text: I didn't think anyone would come.

fdff3fed62.speaker: vesna
fdff3fed62.text: Tell me what it doesn't say.

fe2d093b4a.speaker: dobra
fe2d093b4a.text: I tie it the same way every time. I can't do it any other way.

fee627f7e0.speaker: vesna
fee627f7e0.text: The straw ones on the ice had red thread at the neck. All of them.
